items.title: docs: fix broken section anchors
items.body:
A few docs links point at heading ids that don't exist on h3.dev, so they open the page but don't jump to the section:

- basics/middleware: `lifecycle#\_3-dispatch-request` → `#3-dispatch-request` (the escaped underscore ends up in the href)
- basics/response: `h3event#eventres` → `#h3eventres`
- api/h3event: `request#getrouterparamsevent-opts-decode` → `#getrouterparamsevent-opts--decode-`, and `security#resolvedotsegments` → `#resolvedotsegmentspath-opts` (these are the ids automd generates from the signatures)

I checked every new fragment against the live ids on h3.dev.

Not fixed here: routing.md links `removeRoute` to `/utils/more#removerouteapp-method-route`, but `src/utils/route.ts` (`defineRoute` / `removeRoute`) isn't in any automd block, so that section doesn't exist. Adding a `<!-- automd:jsdocs src="../../src/utils/route.ts" -->` block would cover it. I left that for you to decide.

items.title: fix(sse): preserve empty event ids
items.body:
An SSE message with `id: ""` must send an empty `id` field so an EventSource client can clear its last event ID. The current truthiness check drops that field, leaving the previous reconnection cursor in effect. The [HTML SSE specification](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#parsing-an-event-stream) defines an empty `id` value as resetting the last event ID.

Check whether the optional ID is a string so empty IDs are emitted and omitted IDs remain omitted. Wire-format regressions cover both a single message and an empty ID following a non-empty ID in a batch.

Validation on Node 24.21.0:
- Both new wire-format cases fail before the fix; all 53 SSE unit and integration tests pass after it.
- Lint, formatting, typecheck and `pnpm build` pass.
- The full unmodified test fixture run reports only the existing loopback IP expectation failure (`::ffff:127.0.0.1`); 3,037 tests pass, 51 skip after `pnpm build` (matching the CI build/test order). Applying the independent loopback test expectation locally allows the full suite to pass (3,038 passed, 51 skipped); that test-only change is excluded from this PR.


<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Empty event IDs are now included in formatted event stream messages, both individually and in batches. IDs continue to have newline characters removed.
* **Documentation**
  * Clarified that an empty event ID resets the client’s last event ID, while omitting the ID leaves it unchanged.
  * Added documentation explaining that event stream comments are terminated by a blank line.
